title: Trying the Virtue of the Word of God
author: Neal A. Maxwell
source_file: epub/!Ready/If Thou Endure It Well - Neal A Maxwell.epub
note: 1996 Bookcraft. Title from D&C 121:8. 12-chapter treatise on Christian endurance and consecration — culmination of Maxwell's adversity/endurance arc (alongside All These Things 1979 and But for a Small Moment 1986). Written in his 15th year as Q12 apostle.
